# Ad On AI

> Ad On AI trains non-technical staff at Australian small and medium businesses (SMEs) to use AI in the work they already do — then to build the automations and AI agents that handle the rest. Its self-paced program of 24 hands-on modules ends with every learner holding 20+ working AI builds for their own job, supported by Claude Certified Experts. Ad On AI is a division of Ad On Group, an Australian business services provider operating since 2008 in Australia, the Philippines and South Africa. Skills are tool-agnostic: Claude is the worked example, and they carry across to ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and Grok.

## Our Program (one page: https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs)

- [Our Program — overview](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs): The AI Enablement program in full: how it works, the 24-module curriculum, role coverage and the 20+ builds every learner deploys.
- [Curriculum](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs#curriculum): Three topics — The essential skills (modules 1–8), Automation (9–16) and AI agents (17–24) — each module ending in a real deliverable.
- [What they walk away with](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs#walk-away-with): 20+ working AI builds per learner, minimum: prompts, AI skills, multimodal tasks, end-to-end workflows, agents, a lead agent, scheduled jobs and a browser automation.
- [For BPO and outsourced teams](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs#bpo): A structured, month-by-month track from novice to advanced AI user, with monthly skills checks and progress reporting.
- [Ongoing support (membership)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs#support): One-on-one support, masterclasses, a monthly AI trends webinar, podcasts, a newsletter and a closed community of other learners; separate from the program fee.
- [Program FAQs](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs#faqs): 16 answered questions on the program, the BPO track and ongoing support.
- AI Intermediate: a shorter, six-module program focused on getting Claude working day to day, without AI agents. Details on a discovery call.

## Resources (plain-English AI guides for Australian business)

- [Resources hub](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources): All guides, written by Claude Certified Experts.
- [AI Agent Examples for Small Business (Real, Practical Uses)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-agent-examples-for-small-business): Practical AI agent examples for small business — from triaging enquiries to chasing invoices — with a simple rule for which tasks to trust an agent with. Written for non-technical Australian teams.
- [AI Agent vs Chatbot: What's the Difference?](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-agent-vs-chatbot): A chatbot answers the question you ask. An AI agent is given a goal and works out the steps itself. The plain-English difference, a comparison table, and when a business needs each.
- [AI Automation Examples for Small Business (Real, Practical Uses)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-automation-examples-for-small-business): Practical AI automation examples for small business — from invoice reconciliation to scheduled reporting — with a simple rule for which repetitive jobs to automate first.
- [AI Automation vs AI Workflow: The Plain-English Difference](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-automation-vs-ai-workflow): AI automation follows fixed rules; an AI workflow lets AI make judgement calls. Here's the plain-English difference, with Australian small-business examples of when to use each.
- [AI for Finance Teams: Real Tasks for Australian SMEs](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-for-finance-teams): Practical, high-value AI uses for finance teams at Australian small businesses — variance commentary, invoice chasing, reconciliation prep and supplier comparisons, not generic email drafting.
- [AI Hallucinations: Why AI Gets Things Wrong (and How to Check)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-hallucinations): An AI hallucination is when AI states something false as if it's true, because it predicts plausible language rather than looking up facts. Why it happens, what it looks like, and a simple habit to catch it.
- [10 AI Prompts for Finance Teams (Free Download)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-prompts-for-finance-teams): Ten ready-to-use AI prompts for Australian SME finance teams — variance commentary, invoice chasing, reconciliation prep, supplier comparisons and more. Free PDF download.
- [AI Training vs Learning AI Yourself: Which Is Right for Your Team?](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-training-vs-learning-ai-yourself): Should your team learn AI on their own or through structured training? An honest look at the trade-offs — cost, speed, consistency and accountability — for Australian small businesses.
- [Best AI Tools for Australian Small Business (2026)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/best-ai-tools-for-australian-small-business): A short, honest shortlist of AI tools that genuinely help Australian small businesses — matched to real tasks, not a 30-tool listicle. Which to pick based on the software you already use.
- [ChatGPT vs Copilot vs Gemini vs Claude: Which for Business?](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/chatgpt-vs-copilot-vs-gemini): A plain-English comparison of ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and Claude for Australian businesses — by what each is best at and which fits the tools you already use.
- [How to Use Claude Sheets, Whiteboards & Meetings (2026 Guide)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/claude-sheets-whiteboards-meetings): A quick, visual guide to Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Meetings: how to turn them on, what each does, and 15 copy-paste prompts for budgets, quotes, plans and meeting notes.
- [The 3 Claude Skills to Install (Links + Install Guide)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/best-claude-skills-to-install): Links and step-by-step install guide for the 3 Claude skills that cover 80% of what you need: Video Shotcraft, Apple Design and Humanizer. For the Claude app and Claude Code.
- [Claude vs ChatGPT for Australian Business: An Honest Comparison](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/claude-vs-chatgpt-for-business): Claude vs ChatGPT for Australian small businesses — a fair, tool-agnostic comparison by real task types, with a simple way to choose. Both are highly capable; the right one depends on your work.
- [How to Write an AI Prompt That Actually Works (Step by Step)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/how-to-write-an-ai-prompt): How to write a good AI prompt: give it context, a role, a clear task and a format, then add an example. A simple step-by-step that turns vague asks into reliable results — no tech skills needed.
- [What Are Claude Skills? A Plain-English Guide for Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-are-claude-skills): Claude Skills are reusable packages of instructions that teach Claude to do a specific task your way — so you don't re-explain it every time. What they are, why they matter, with an Australian small-business example.
- [What Is an AI Agent? A Plain-English Guide (+ Agentic AI)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-an-ai-agent): An AI agent is given a goal and works out the steps to reach it — choosing actions and using tools, not just answering. Here's what that means in plain English, with an Australian small-business example.
- [What Is an LLM (Large Language Model)? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-an-llm): An LLM is the AI technology behind tools like ChatGPT and Claude — trained on huge amounts of text to predict and generate language. What that means in plain English, and why it's sometimes confidently wrong.
- [What Is Claude Cowork? A Plain-English Guide for Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-claude-cowork): Claude Cowork is Anthropic's AI coworker — it reads, edits and creates files in folders you allow, and runs whole tasks unattended. What it actually does, and a real small-business example.
- [What Is Claude in Chrome? Browser Automation Explained](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-claude-in-chrome): Claude for Chrome is a browser extension that lets Claude navigate, click and fill forms on your behalf. What it actually does, the safety guardrails, and a real small-business example.
- [What Is Prompt Engineering? A Plain-English Guide for Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-prompt-engineering): Prompt engineering is writing clear, well-structured instructions so AI produces useful, reliable work. What it means in plain English — and why your non-technical staff can learn it.
- [What Is RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-rag): RAG is when AI looks up your own documents before answering, instead of relying only on what it learned in training. What that means in plain English, and why it makes AI answers more trustworthy.
- [AI Readiness Quiz for Australian Small Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/tools/ai-readiness-quiz): A free 2-minute AI readiness quiz for Australian small businesses. Answer 8 questions to see where your team stands and get tailored next steps — no email required, nothing sent anywhere.

## Glossary

- [AI Glossary: Plain-English Definitions for Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary): A plain-English AI glossary — short, jargon-free definitions of the terms Australian businesses run into, from AI agents and LLMs to prompts, RAG and hallucination, each with a real-world example.
- [What Is a Context Window? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/context-window): A context window is the amount of text an AI can hold in mind at once — your conversation, anything pasted in, and its own replies. What happens when you go past it, and why it matters.
- [What Is Fine-Tuning in AI? A Plain-English Guide](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/fine-tuning): Fine-tuning is further training an existing AI model on extra examples so it gets better at a specific style or task. How it differs from a prompt or a skill, and why most businesses don't need it.
- [What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/mcp): MCP is an open standard, introduced by Anthropic, for connecting AI assistants to outside tools and data sources in a consistent way. What it means for a small business, in plain English.
- [What Is Multimodal AI? A Plain-English Guide](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/multimodal): Multimodal AI can work with more than just text — images, audio, and sometimes documents or video — not only read and write words. What that unlocks for everyday business use.
- [What Is an Orchestrator Agent? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/orchestrator-agent): An orchestrator agent is an AI agent whose job is to coordinate other agents or steps — breaking a big goal into parts and pulling the results together. The project manager of a multi-agent setup.
- [What Is a Prompt? A Plain-English Definition](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/prompt): A prompt is the instruction or question you give an AI. Everything you type to get a response is a prompt — and the clearer and more specific it is, the better the result.
- [What Is a Token in AI? Explained Simply](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/glossary/token): A token is the small chunk of text an AI reads and generates — roughly a word or a piece of a word. Why usage, limits and cost are often measured in tokens.

## Same organisation: Ad On AI and Ad On Group

Ad On AI (https://www.adon-ai.com.au) is the AI training and enablement division of Ad On Group (https://adongroup.com.au). They are the same business, not separate companies. The same program is described on Ad On Group's own site at https://adongroup.com.au/ai-training/ and https://adongroup.com.au/ad-on-ai/.

## Key facts

- Audience: non-technical staff at Australian SMEs — finance, operations, marketing, admin, customer service, sales and EA/VA roles. No technical background needed.
- Format: online and self-paced, in the Ad On AI Academy (AI is built into the platform). Every module is open from day one.
- Length: 24 modules, under 24 hours of self-guided learning; the program includes lifetime access to the Learning Academy.
- Outcome: 20+ working AI builds per learner, plus a documented record of hours reclaimed and work now handled automatically.
- Accountability: every module includes a test or practical project; learners can't progress without completing it, and managers are notified if someone stalls. Leadership gets a monthly progress report.
- Support: hands-on, 1-on-1 help from Claude Certified Experts when someone gets stuck (email a trainer or book a 1-hour call from inside any lesson).
- Published results: 80+ Ad On Group staff trained in AI; 40+ Australian businesses trained; Ad On AI reports 12 hours saved per person each week and deployed AI agents within 3 months.
- Facilitators: Dylan Bailey and Beau Robards, both Claude Certified (Anthropic certifications).
- Contact: info@adongroup.com.au · (07) 5586 1400 · 1/44 Township Drive, Burleigh Heads QLD 4219, Australia · ABN 54 808 983 598
